title: Impact evidence
aboutLink: See catalogue coverage and sourced evidence
basis: Computed on {count} synthetic personas from the live catalogue and trend snapshot; no human trials.
honest: Measured on synthetic personas; no human pilot has been run.
estimate: Catalogue counts describe stored reference records. Plans and scenarios are estimates on synthetic profiles. HRD Corp eligibility is not approved funding.

free.label: Free courses in a pathway
free.note: Median share of courses. By hours: {hours}. HRD Corp-claimable: {hrd}.
free.formula: Free courses (cost 0) divided by courses in the path, per persona; median across personas.

hours.label: Median pathway hours
hours.formula: Sum of hours of the distinct courses the pathway engine selects; median across personas.

sdg.label: SDG targets per pathway
sdg.note: Distinct UN SDG targets the path's skills contribute to (median).
sdg.formula: Distinct targets on the pathway steps, from the reviewed skill-to-target mapping.

scenario.label: Roles that change with the scenario
scenario.note: Median count of top-5 roles that differ between Moderate and Fast. Top role changed for {count} personas.
scenario.formula: Roles in the Moderate top 5 that are not in the Fast top 5, same profile and scorer.

fairness.label: Largest rank change when identity is swapped
fairness.note: {variants} name and segment swaps re-ranked. Guardrail report passed: {passed}.
fairness.formula: Largest change in any role's rank after swapping name and segment, run through the production matcher now.

coverage.label: Courses in the catalogue
coverage.note: {roles} roles, {skills} skills. {fresh} of courses verified within {days} days before the catalogue date {date}.
coverage.formula: Counts resolve to stored records. The verification window ends at the newest course verification date, separate from the trend snapshot.
coverage.title: Catalogue coverage

personas.title: Per-persona results (Moderate scenario)
personas.note: Personas are the synthetic demo profiles in the repository. Each is run through the real matching and pathway functions.

why.title: Why this matters
why.lead: Figures quoted from public pages, with publisher and date.
why.labour: Labour context (DOSM Labour Force Survey, {month}): unemployment {rate}%. Retrieved {date}.

feature.catalogue: The course catalogue lists free and HRD Corp-claimable courses with verified dates.
feature.matching: Role matching shows which roles fit your skills today.
feature.radar: The trend radar tracks emerging roles and skills with dated sources.
feature.profile: Skills intake turns a CV into a profile you confirm and edit.
feature.pathway: Pathways close skill gaps with free or HRD Corp-claimable courses (computed above).
feature.scenarios: Moderate and Fast scenarios show how plans change as AI adoption speeds up.
feature.org: Team plans show which courses may be HRD Corp-claimable; eligibility is not approved funding.

historical: Scenario calculations use historical arXiv observations from {from} to {to}, replayed under demo snapshot labels; they are not current research.

catalogueFree.label: Free catalogue coverage
catalogueFree.formula: Courses whose stored learning price is zero; sum of their listed hours. This is catalogue availability, not completed training.

catalogueSdg.label: SDG targets linked
catalogueSdg.formula: Distinct official targets resolved through the reviewed role and skill mappings; alignment is not a measured development outcome.
